purpose: Define deterministic discovery of installable/runtime artifacts from declared library roots using explicit manifests/types rather than arbitrary filename heuristics.

topics.name: Library Discovery
topics.purpose: Define deterministic discovery of installable/runtime artifacts from declared library roots using explicit manifests/types rather than arbitrary filename heuristics.

semantics.discovery_rule: Discovery scans only declared roots/subroots according to explicit artifact profiles.
semantics.manifest_rule: Machine-significant installable artifacts expose explicit identity/type/version/dependency metadata.
semantics.type_rule: UM, MCP, tool and web resources remain distinguishable artifact classes.
semantics.order_rule: Filesystem enumeration/alphabetical order never establishes semantic precedence.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Same-identity duplicates enter explicit source/authority resolution.
semantics.inert_rule: Discovery is read-only and never imports/loads/executes discovered code.
semantics.failure_rule: Malformed/unknown artifact remains undiscovered/invalid with explicit finding rather than guessed classification.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

references.purpose: Duplicate artifacts use explicit authority resolution.
